key: State of Carbon Dioxide Removal (background data source for current CDR levels) || 3rd Edition published 2 June 2026 (Edwards, Geden, Gidden, Lamb et al., doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/ZRD65). Key updated figures: total CDR = 2.2 GtCO2/yr (conventional 99.9% = ~2.2 GtCO2/yr, novel = ~0.002 GtCO2/yr = 2 MtCO2/yr). The '3% of net GHG emissions' framing has changed to '5% of gross CO2 emissions.' Novel CDR figure (2 MtCO2/yr) is unchanged. The 2nd Edition (2024) gave novel CDR as 1.3 MtCO2/yr (0.0013 GtCO2/yr), the 3rd Edition gives ~0.002 GtCO2/yr (2 MtCO2/yr), suggesting growth. The draft's '2 MtCO2/yr' for novel CDR is consistent with the 3rd Edition figure but not the 2nd Edition figure (1.3 MtCO2/yr)
